summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, with numpy and torch.nn.functional imports and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run; the tests and spec numeric checks are unverified. I hand-checked the batch-of-two example (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333). Changes are uncommitted. Open choices: numpy float64 matrices produce float64 losses; an all-zero matrix is not guarded against division by zero. A pre-existing 128-column line at dice.py:36 was left alone.
